title: Arizona Revised Statutes, Title 43 (Taxation of Income), Chapter 10 - Individuals (selected sections)
deposited: A.R.S. title 43, chapter 10, selected sections on individuals: definitions (43-1001, 43-1002), the tax rates in both versions the register prints (43-1011), additions and subtractions, including the subtraction of Social Security benefits included in federal AGI under IRC s86 (43-1021, 43-1022), exemptions for age 65 and blindness (43-1023), the standard and itemized deductions (43-1041, 43-1042), the credit for taxes paid to other states (43-1071), the property tax credit for residents 65 or over or receiving SSI (43-1072), the increased excise tax credit (43-1072.01), the family income tax credit (43-1073) and the dependent tax credit (43-1073.01).
version: Arizona Revised Statutes online, updated through the 57th Legislature, 2nd Regular Session (2026)
as_at: law effective January 1 of the year following the 2026 session, as the register describes its compilation
converter: azleg section HTML (/ars/<title>/<section>.htm) to plain text with BeautifulSoup, sections concatenated (scratchpad script az_convert.py, not deposited; tools are kept outside commons)
official_status: unofficial: the register says the online version is 'primarily maintained for legislative drafting purposes' and that 'The official version of the Arizona Revised Statutes is published by Thomson Reuters'
